messages:
Maya (AE): FYI we received an RFP from Meridian Systems. They want RFI answers + a 3-week POC focusing on embeddings search + latency SLOs. Main asks: POC timeline, cost for ~30M tokens gen + 5M embeddings, KMS/HSM details, and sample capability matrix. Can SE/security/SRE sync now?

Ravi (SE): Happy to. Proposed POC: 3 weeks, week1 ingest & integration, week2 performance tuning + Dedicated pool, week3 acceptance and handoff. Need anonymized sample data, SSO test account, and acceptance criteria (recall@k, 99th p95 latency targets). Who will own the capability matrix doc?

Maya (AE): I'll draft the matrix. Pricing: quick guidance? Also Meridian asked about POC discount and contract terms for a short pilot.

Ravi (SE): Hand-wave pricing for planning: gen $0.00055/token, embeddings $0.0009/embedding. For a 3-week POC we can propose a 30% POC discount on committed usage or a fixed POC cap. Recommend Dedicated if they care about stable tail latency.

Lena (Security): RFI security checklist items: customer-managed KMS, HSM for on-prem, audit log retention, SOC2 evidence, data residency. Suggested short answer to paste: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and Azure Key Vault. For Private/on-prem deployments we support HSM integrations; Redwood does not extract customer private key material. Audit logs for admin and access events can be retained per contract; standard retention 90 days with extensions available."

Ravi (SE): Good, I'll include that. Also add a note about model catalog and fallback routing to a compatible model variant if Dedicated capacity is constrained.

Chris (SRE): We have a 2-GPU Dedicated test pool free in us-east-1 during the proposed window. Suggest autoscale min=1, max=3. I'll reserve it and produce a brief POC runbook (deploy steps, metrics to capture, escalation). Will set up cost tracking tags so finance can estimate consumption.

Maya (AE): Great. I'll ask contracts about a one-page POC addendum and request SOC2 redacted link from security. Action items: Maya upload capability_matrix_draft, Ravi finalize RFI answers, Lena share SOC2/KMS links and one-paragraph HSM wording, Chris reserve pool + runbook.

POC-bot: Created ticket POC-4877 assigned to Ravi (SE) due 1718070000.

Ravi (SE): I'll update the ticket once the RFI bundle is ready. If anyone has concise legal-friendly HSM phrasing, paste it here. :pray: 

Lena (Security): Dropping links to redacted SOC2 and KMS guide (contract access only): https://vault.redwood/soc2/redacted and https://vault.redwood/kms-guide. I'll DM contracts for POC addendum language.

Maya (AE): Thanks team — target to send Meridian the full RFI + POC proposal by tomorrow 08:30 PT. :thumbsup:
